reviews.review: Super addictive and fun to play, challenging at some times.

Well what can i say ? it has tons of flaws on the technical side is cluncky and overall riddled with various issiues ? why thumbs up ? because of the scale and content ( and mods/modability ) for me its the ultimate "do what you want" sandbox. The series spawned for example the legendary DayZ mod that got a standalone wich not long ago got its full release. The most played gametypes/variants have almost nothing to do anymore with the vanilla basegameplay like Altis life wich i barely played but its the most popular mode in Arma 3 and is basicly a roleplay mode remi9nding me alot sometimes with GTA SA multiplaer mod life servers . Followed by that is King of the hill wich is basicly 100% 3 team action killing each other trying to controll a area on the map ( often a large city or something ofthat kind ). There are of course official servers and modes wich range from classic modes scaled up from other games / tactical shooter kind of modes / Milsim modes and of course "Zeus" wich is basicly a sandbox scenario where a "gamemaster" ( an other player ) uses the tools of the games to create missions games campaigns etc for the players (bouth pvp and pve). Often Milsim kidn of servers acctuly let humans fight against AI. the tools the game gives you and the Steam workshop also give you an almost unlimited singleplayer experience thinking alone about the thousands of player createt missions for the game. Now comes the big BUT. If you are looking for a good Milsim / tacitcal shooter experience ( basicly the vanilla game XD ) you will not get the best experience in arma. Public servers are a mess you dont want to have. Non public clans that do that often requiere you to have a ton of mods ( in particular cup maps and RHS ) etc and evrything is just problematic ( you get kicked when you are not online for 3 weeks etc whatever and you need to adjust to the Clans playtimes and not yours ) . The technical side puts the final nail. evraything is super cluncky slow and not smooth .... the tools for organisation are bad , AI is often very broken or straith up cheats in some situations, the game runs horribly even on a 40 player only scenario ( and overall it dont run that good ) ... imagining haveing more players with tons of scripts running ai and other stuff GG framerate......... and ton of other stuff i could mention .... when you seek that Tacitcal/Milsim expereince go for Squad its in my opinion the best game of that genre out there .  but armas tool/sandbox its scale and content make it for evrything else an not regretable choice

Where to start............
CONS
 
the engine is total ♥♥♥♥ !!!!. 
multiplayer server perfomance is poor
the ammount of content isnt much at all (needs MORE WEAPONS)
no shotgun............WTF
no support for ballstics and wind
ASSLOADS of bugs. some that are gamebreaking
little to no support for errors
most of all (steam ticket check fail) WTF IS THAT??? its been in the game since alpha why hasnt it been fixed. why does this game continue to crash randomly???


PROS.......... 
the community
mods (better than BI could make IMO)
VERY VERY VERY slow improvements
flexability 



if you are considering this game PLEASE think it through, it can be fun but there are MANY problems.

i wish i could get a refund honestly
